info.title: rust-web-dashboard
info.description: Standalone Rust web dashboard for a DCS-gRPC server (single-binary axum + tonic)

get.summary:
`GET /api/atmosphere?lat=&lon=&alt=` → wind + temperature/pressure
(AtmosphereService). `alt` defaults to 0, matching the source.

post.summary: `POST /api/auth` — exchange the admin password for a session JWT.

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/auth` — logout. JWTs are stateless, so this is a client cue.

get.summary:
`GET /api/auth/callback` — complete the OAuth flow and redirect to the UI
with a session token in the URL fragment, or an error query on failure.

303.description: Redirect to UI with token or error

get.summary: `GET /api/auth/discord` — redirect the browser to Discord's OAuth consent.
`GET /api/auth/verify` — confirm a bearer token is valid.
`GET /api/graveyard` -> Returns the current live graveyard JSON

get.description:
Intentionally public so the login screen can surface server status before a
session exists. Process liveness lives at `GET /healthz`.

500.description: Failed to connect to DCS server

get.summary:
`GET /api/logs/access` → authentication audit log, mapped to the frontend
shape (`timestamp` ms / `userId`).

`GET /api/mission` → current mission + paused state (HookService) plus
filesystem-derived `serverInfo`, `queue`, and `uploadedMissions`.
get.description:
Per-call gRPC failures fall back to `"Unknown"` / `false`, matching the
source's individual `.catch(...)` handling. A `serverSettings.lua` parse
failure yields `serverInfo: null` and an empty queue, as in the source.

post.summary:
`POST /api/mission` → mission control actions (HookService). Queue
mutation (`add_to_queue` / `remove_from_queue`) is filesystem-backed and
returns `501` until Phase 5.

get.summary:
`GET /api/mission/browse` → recursively list `.miz` files under `Missions`
(depth ≤ 3, skipping hidden folders and `Uploads`).
`GET /api/server/dcs-process` → check if DCS.exe or DCS_server.exe is running.
`GET /api/server/services` -> list status of configured Windows services.

`GET /api/settings` → parsed `serverSettings.lua` (flat object with the
`advanced` block, `missionList` array, and primitive keys).

post.summary:
`POST /api/triggers` → set user flag (TriggerService.SetUserFlag). The
source coerced `flag` via `.toString()` and `value` via `Number(...)`.

get.summary:
`GET /api/weather` → presets + current applied weather state. Overrides the
reported mission name with the live DCS mission when reachable.

post.summary: `POST /api/weather/apply` → run the weather generator and reload the mission.
